Trump Administration Actions on H-1B Visas, Vaccines, and Food Disclosure

The Trump administration is reportedly planning new actions concerning H-1B visas, targeting three specific loopholes. Separately, President Trump has indicated a desire to sign an executive order that would space out childhood vaccinations into multiple shots. The FDA, under the administration, has ordered increased disclosure of food ingredients and has delayed a crackdown on ultraprocessed foods proposed by Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Additionally, President Trump revealed he secretly changed aircraft in Turkey due to a threat, with advisors wanting him off Air Force One. The Department of Justice under Trump's administration is also allowing the president to keep more communications private.
